results.headline: Topology-sensitive. The canonical represented route is 7944 m, but falls to 4916 m if the unresolved crossing is an at-grade junction.

whatPassed: canonical 7,944.412 m, matching the audit to the metre, returned unchanged and never displaced
counterfactual 4,915.533 m, matching the audit's 4,915.5 m
the corridor source found the causal crossing - the closure source found NOTHING, which is the whole point: a buffer round the clicked link would have missed it
the counterfactual never occupied the canonical slot
the transient copy was marked is_transient and coverage_kind=counterfactual, and was dropped; zero transient snapshots left behind; national snapshot intact at 375,696 links

gapsFoundByRunningIt.gap: The decoy crossing (Clintons x Greendale) was NOT in the candidate set at all.
gapsFoundByRunningIt.why_it_matters: The acceptance asks that it be found and correctly NOT credited with the change. It was not found, so 'not credited' is vacuous rather than demonstrated. decoyCrossingIsMaterial=false is true but proves nothing.
gapsFoundByRunningIt.likely_cause: It sits beside the closure, and the closure source returned 0 candidates - so either the closure radius or the noded/safe_to_node filter excluded it. Needs investigation, not assumption.

gapsFoundByRunningIt.gap: Crossing names did not resolve - the headline reads 'unnamed road x unnamed road' where the audit names Clintons Road x McLaughlins Road.
gapsFoundByRunningIt.why_it_matters: The headline is the sentence a user reads. Unnamed roads make it far less useful, and the join is in candidates.find, so it affects every analysis rather than this one.
gapsFoundByRunningIt.likely_cause: The link_names join is on closure_group_id and returned nothing; the name may live under a different key on this snapshot.

twoBugsThisAcceptanceCaught: MovementPin compared movement_id and port ids, which hash the SNAPSHOT ID into themselves and therefore can never agree across a copy. Every bounded neighbourhood failed validation while agreeing on nodes, all 17 arcs and the distance to the last digit. Failed SAFE - declined rather than accepted - and made the mechanism unusable.
extract_validated fell through to dataclass equality, which compared those same surrogate fields even after the pin was fixed.

openQuestion.what: How do crossings get populated in production?
openQuestion.state: UNRESOLVED. The national snapshot has ZERO rows in `crossings`. This acceptance populated a COPY, which proves the wiring and does NOT prove the production path.
openQuestion.leadingCandidate: Option 3 - detect crossings within the bounded neighbourhood at analysis time, removing the pre-populated-table dependency entirely. It fits the pivot away from national precompute.
openQuestion.doNotConclude: A passing acceptance does not mean production sourcing is solved.
